summary: Short bush-backed kerb near the Sir Fred Schonell junction, homes across the road.
reasons: Backs onto bush and parkland on the east
Homes 30 m or more across the road
Narrow lane; room beside it unclear

best_section.where: East kerb of Bryce Street, south of the apartment driveway near the junction

drivers.seclusion: Bush and park on the kerb side; nearest home is 32 m away across the road, but the apartment at 21 m is 16 m off.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street with two cars parked on the west edge; east side is tree-lined with little visible verge.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street just off Sir Fred Schonell Drive.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the west side; signs are 2P Mon-Fri, no overnight convention.

flags: Slope falls to 8.8% max towards the junction end, flat at the best section
Apartments 16 m away near the north end
Close to a busy arterial junction, some noise
sun_shade: Mostly shaded by trees over the kerb, especially from the east.
cannot_judge: Room beside the lane on the east side
